newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Systems sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Systems sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Pinnacle Systems Inc said on Thursday that its board of directors approved a shareholder rights distribution plan.

The plan will provide shareholders with the right to buy one preferred share for each outstanding share of the company's common stock held. The exercise price for the company's Series A participating preferred stock is $65 a share.

The rights will become exercisable after the announcement of the acquisition of 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or a tender offer that would result in ownership of 15 percent or more of the common stock.
